rationale: Builds directly on the current best two-block recurrent tail and FP16 recurrent Q/K rescue. The repeated tail pass now reuses only the mixed-input plus attention subpath, removing recurrent MLP work and MLP quantization noise while keeping shapes, gates, training loop, and final exact int8+zlib evaluation unchanged. The hypothesis is that the Mac mini gets slightly more useful updates inside 600s and the final roundtrip is helped by concentrating repeated computation on the already-protected attention path.
title: Attention-Only Recurrent Tail On QK-Rescued Best
